_configurationPurpose: Editable Cage Grind fight balance values. The browser validates every supported value and uses built-in defaults when this file is missing or invalid.
_editingInstructions: Change numeric balance values only unless a code change explicitly adds or removes a setting.
Do not rename or remove properties.
Probabilities use decimal values from zero through one.
Multipliers use one as the unchanged baseline.
Minimum values must not exceed their matching maximum values.
Run npm test after changing this file.

_unitConventions.probability: A decimal from 0 through 1, where 0.20 means a twenty percent chance.
_unitConventions.multiplier: A decimal where 1 means unchanged, 0.50 means half, and 1.25 means twenty-five percent more.
_unitConventions.percentagePoint: A whole or decimal number on a 0 through 100 scale.
_unitConventions.inclusiveMinimumAndMaximum: Both the stated minimum and maximum may occur.

fightStructure._description: Limits and eligibility shared by ordinary, ranked, and championship fights.

_safeRanges.scheduledRounds: Currently fixed at 3 because the adaptation and final-round systems are designed around three rounds

dailyDevelopmentLimits._description: Daily limits on actions that permanently increase fighter attributes. Gym training and sparring use separate counters.

energyEconomy._description: The four-segment battery economy. Gym training requires and costs one complete twenty-five-point segment. Sparring has exact twenty-five, fifty, or seventy-five point costs defined by its action tier. Other consuming actions may begin with any Energy above zero and spend up to one segment.

_safeRanges.maximumEnergy: Currently fixed at 100 so the battery always has four equal segments
_safeRanges.energySegmentSize: Currently fixed at 25 so every action and recovery remains on a battery segment
_safeRanges.minimumEnergyToStartConsumingActionExclu: Currently fixed at 0, meaning any Energy above zero permits an Energy-consuming action
_safeRanges.restSecondsPerMissingEnergySegment: 1 through 15; Rest always fills the battery and multiplies this time by the number of missing twenty-five-point segments
_safeRanges.energyDrinkEnergyRestored: Currently fixed at 25 so one drink restores exactly one battery segment

recoveryEconomy._description: Health-only Recovery Room pricing. Every treatment charges the same amount per Health point, preventing a discount from repeating smaller treatments.

exchangeCounts._description: Inclusive number of simulated exchanges in each round.

computerGeneratedOpponentDifficulty._description: Attribute growth for fictional career opponents. Real Cage Network fighters continue to use their own saved build.
computerGeneratedOpponentDifficulty._balanceNotes: Levels one through three remain on the original linear curve. The multiplier first applies at level four and compounds once per level after that. Raising the multiplier has a much larger effect late in a career.

fatigue._description: Accuracy loss accumulated as rounds and exchanges progress.

focus._description: Temporary fight-only Focus generated in the locker room.

startingCondition._description: Starting in-fight Condition selected from persistent Health percentage.

_safeRanges.allHealthPercentThresholds: 0 through 100, ordered from highest tier to lowest tier
_safeRanges.allConditionValues: 0 through 100, ordered from highest tier to lowest tier

persistentHealthDamage._description: Persistent Health removed by confirmed opponent offense and losing finishes.

roundScoring._description: Weights used to compare each fighter's round performance.

cashAndExperienceRewards._description: Purse and experience modifiers. Multipliers use one as the unchanged baseline.

_safeRanges.lowerLevelOpponentExperienceMultiplier: Currently fixed at 0 so opponents below the player's level never award experience
_safeRanges.sameDayRunbackExperienceMultiplier: Currently fixed at 0.5 so the one same-day runback after a win awards half experience
